user.title: Set up Locking Cover
user.description: Creates a new Locking Cover lock as a wrapper around an existing cover entity. The same sensor may be selected for both bolt sensors for testing purposes; this will be flagged as a diagnostic repair issue.

abort.already_configured: This source cover is already configured as a Locking Cover.

cannot_lock.message: Cannot lock: the cover must be closed and both bolts must be locked.

identical_bolt_sensors.title: Identical bolt sensors configured
identical_bolt_sensors.description: For '{name}', the left and right bolt sensor are the same entity. This is only intended for testing. Please select two different sensors in the options as soon as they are available.

reset_error.name: Reset error
reset_error.description: Clears the last recorded error of a Locking Cover instance.

config_entry_id.name: Instance
config_entry_id.description: The Locking Cover config entry whose error should be cleared.

force_relax.name: Force relax
force_relax.description: Manually triggers a relax (down-pulse) sequence regardless of the current state. Intended for maintenance/recovery.

config_entry_id.name: Instance
config_entry_id.description: The Locking Cover config entry to relax.
